(3) The tiny grid (282 CTAs) cannot saturate 132 SMs. Adding @triton.autotune with smaller BLOCK_M values (64, 32) and varying num_warps/num_stages will: reduce register pressure → more blocks/SM → higher occupancy; expose configurations that avoid bank conflicts; and allow the autotuner to find the optimal tile shape for this M=36000, N=24, K=96 problem.
